title: Infinitely many new solutions for a nonlinear coupled Schrödinger system
summary: We revisit the following nonlinear Schrödinger system \begin{align*}\begin{cases} -ε^{2}Δu +P(x) u= μ_1 u^3 +βuv^2, &~\text{in}\;\mathbb {R}^3,\\ -ε^{2}Δv+Q(x) v= μ_2 v^3 +βu^2v, &~\text{in}\;\mathbb{ R}^3, \end{cases} \end{align*} where $ε$ is a positive parameter, $P(x),\,Q(x)$ are the potential functions, $μ_1>0$, $μ_2>0$ and $β\in\mathbb R$ is a coupling constant. Employing the finite dimensional reduction method, we prove that there are new kind of synchronized and segregated solutions, which concentrate both in a bounded domain and near infinity, and present a special structure.…
